scope: Fixed D7 030-039; no new model runs, no measured analyst time
inputs: Both methods use identical native parent/child sessions, baseline hashes, final workspace, user-authorized directories and raw tool contents
baseline: Automated flat-log analysis. Parse native calls chronologically and infer file operations without importing/building/reading graphs. Include child calls at the parent task, retain failed/invalid returns. No known injection path or scenario labels supplied.
shared_components: Trajectory parsing/normalization, lexical authorization, raw-call serialization, existing shell.py heuristics, and a graph-free implementation of the fixed C2-v1 content scoring/visibility rules. Sharing does not provide extra observations to either method.
graph: C1 unreconciled graph writer detection and backward reachability; C2 source identity from file READ edges and the same fixed content score
detection_unit: Actual native write operations identified by run/session/call/path; exclude delegated parent summary duplicates. Also compare final changed protected paths independently.
acceptance_reference: Existing manual review/handover native edits plus independent before/final file hashes; known run/call/document labels are lookup-only after both methods finish
source_eligibility: Only effective violating starts with confirmed prior complete payload exposure. Report 4 runs and 8 starts separately. Do not force sources for six legal runs.
candidate_unit: Single file source for direct read/skill returns; other returns remain individual candidates. Same-session earlier-turn and timestamp constraints on both sides; no parent history presumed visible in child. Repeated file reads take max score; ties retained.
source_metrics: Per-start candidate count, controlled-document coverage, score and tie rank interval on both sides. Coverage is lookup, not source causality.

volume_metrics.graph_fraction: Ancestor nodes excluding target / all nodes in same complete session graph excluding target. All node kinds counted; child and parent separate.
volume_metrics.comparable_prefix: Count native call identities excluding target in graph ancestors versus flat same-session prior-turn calls satisfying the same temporal boundary. This removes the advantage of comparing a time prefix to a full future log.
volume_metrics.record_counts: Report complete-run parent+child native call counts for input parity; graph node counts are not directly divided by flat-log rows or files.

rarity: Keep C3 exploratory results separate. No tuned fusion or source ranking weights.
human_time: Not measured; no reading-time, productivity or human-effort claim.
interpretation: Equal localization/ranking or no call-prefix reduction is an admissible result. Do not weaken the baseline or tune rules after seeing results.
